topIssues.title: tryStorageLayoutLookup in AccountAccessParser should be able to handled tightly packed variables
topIssues.author: blmalone
topIssues.body:
> We should make whatever decoding approach we come up with mirror what it looks like in tenderly.



Right now the `tryStorageLayoutLookup` function has the following function signature: 
```solidity
function tryStorageLayoutLookup(string memory _contractName, bytes32 _slot, bytes32 _oldValue, bytes32 _newValue)
        internal
        view
        returns (DecodedSlot memory decoded_)
```

In reality, many changes can occur in a single slot, so we could change this function to return an array: 
```solidity
function tryStorageLayoutLookup(string memory _contractName, bytes32 _slot, bytes32 _oldValue, bytes32 _newValue)
        internal
        view
        returns (DecodedSlot[] memory decoded_)
```

right now, if we detected a slot that is shared, we don't try to decode it. Completing this issue would require being able to decode these shared slots: 

```solidity
            if (isSlotShared(layout, _slot)) {
                return DecodedSlot({kind: "", oldValue: "", newValue: "", summary: "", detail: ""});
            }
```

topPRs.title: feat(eip712): enable eip712 typed data to be provided to eip712sign lib
topPRs.author: blmalone
topPRs.body:
### TL;DR

Add support for EIP-712 structured data signing for Safe transactions, allowing signers to use tools that support typed data signing.

### What changed?

- Added a new environment variable `EIP712_ENCODED_DATA_TO_SIGN` to control whether to use EIP-712 typed data JSON for signing or just the domain and message hashes (default)
- Implemented `encodeEIP712Json` to generate properly formatted EIP-712 JSON for Safe transactions
- Renamed and enhanced `getDomainAndMessageHashFromEncodedTransactionData` to `getDomainAndMessageHashFromDataToSign` to handle both formats
- Updated the MultisigTask to support both signing methods while ensuring they produce the same hashes
- Added comprehensive tests for the new EIP-712 JSON signing functionality

topPRs.title: feat: support Tenderly's new ?draft= simulation link format
topPRs.author: sbvegan
topPRs.body:
## Context

Tenderly shipped a breaking change to how the Simulator hydrates a pre-filled form from a URL ([Slack thread](https://oplabs-pbc.slack.com/archives/C053NFWLG9K/p1781002848689189)). The old query-param format we emitted (`?network=…&contractAddress=…&from=…&stateOverrides=…&rawFunctionInput=…`) **no longer applies state overrides or gas** — signers had to re-enter everything by hand, defeating the purpose of the printed link.

The [new format](https://tenderlydev.notion.site/Simulator-draft-links-draft-37b84be6a2e680bb9874f18a833c1997) encodes the whole simulation as a single JSON payload, base64url-encoded (no padding), in a `?draft=` query parameter:

```
https://dashboard.tenderly.co/<org>/<project>/simulator/new?draft=<base64url(json)>
```

```json
{
  "v": 1,
  "network": { "id": "<chainid>" },
  "row": {
    "contractAddress": "<to>",
    "from": "<from>",
    "inputDataType": "raw",
    "rawFunctionInput": "<calldata>",
    "gas": "<TENDERLY_GAS>",
    "stateOverrides": [ { "contractAddress": "0x…", "balance": "", "storage": [ { "key": "0x…", "value": "0x…" } ] } ]
  }
}
```

## What changed

- **`src/libraries/MultisigTaskPrinter.sol`** — new `getTenderlySimulationLink(...)` builds the draft JSON `row`/payload and encodes it with the already-imported solady `Base64.encode(data, /*fileSafe*/ true, /*noPadding*/ true)`. `printTenderlySimulationData` now emits the draft link instead of the old query-param URL. (`Simulation.logSimulationLink` in the `base-contracts` submodule is left untouched; its only remaining callers are archived rehearsal scripts.)
- **Length fallback** — Tenderly's new format caps usable links at ~2000 chars (the old cap was 7980). Since real tasks wrap a Safe `execTransaction` (large calldata), the link is built **without** `rawFunctionInput` and the calldata is printed separately under `Insert the following hex into the 'Raw input data' field:` for manual paste. This mirrors the prior long-URL behavior and is the common path for production tasks.
- **`test/libraries/TenderlySimulationLink.t.sol`** — unit tests pinning the exact draft payload for the inline-calldata, no-raw-input (fallback), and no-gas paths, plus a guard that the legacy `network=`/`stateOverrides=%5B` params are gone.
- **Docs** — `runbooks/key-handover.md` and `docs/simulate-l2-ownership-transfer.md` updated to the new format.

## How it was tested

**Unit tests** (deterministic; env-sensitive assertions kept in one function to avoid the shared-`TENDERLY_GAS` race):
```
forge test --match-path "test/libraries/TenderlySimulationLink.t.sol" -vv
```

**Live Sepolia simulations** (against a real RPC):
- **Single task** — `086-U19-op-betanet-permissioned`, forked at block `10971228` (one before its on-chain execution tx, since 086 is already EXECUTED). Printed a valid draft link + fallback hex.
- **Stacked tasks** — the PR #1440 stack `[099-U19-op-ink-mmz-soneium, 100-U19-unichain]` via `just simulate-stack sep 100-U19-unichain`. Both tasks printed valid draft links.

Each produced link was base64url-decoded and confirmed to be valid JSON with the correct `v`/`network.id`/`contractAddress`/`from`/`gas`/`stateOverrides`.

> Note on stacked links: a downstream task's link can't reproduce the *chain-state* mutations made by earlier tasks in the stack (only Safe threshold/owner/nonce travel in the overrides). This is the pre-existing "stacked Tenderly links may not work" limitation the `simulate-stack` recipe already warns about — not introduced by this change.

## How a reviewer can validate

1. **Run the unit tests:** `forge test --match-path "test/libraries/TenderlySimulationLink.t.sol" -vv` (4 cases, should pass).
2. **Simulate a task** and inspect the printed `Simulation link:` — confirm it is a `…/simulator/new?draft=<b64url>` URL (no legacy query params).
3. **Decode the draft** to confirm the payload is correct:
   ```bash
   python3 -c 'import base64,json,sys; d=sys.argv[1]; print(json.dumps(json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(d+"="*(-len(d)%4))),indent=2))' "<paste the value after ?draft=>"
   ```
   Expect `v:1`, `network.id` = the chain id, and the right `contractAddress`/`from`/`gas`/`stateOverrides`.
4. **Open the link in Tenderly** (replacing `TENDERLY_USERNAME`/`TENDERLY_PROJECT` with your own org/project, or set the `TENDERLY_*` env vars before simulating) and confirm the form pre-fills network, contract, from, gas, and state overrides. For large-calldata tasks, paste the separately-printed hex into "Raw input data".

topPRs.title: feat: Add Trezor Support
topPRs.author: blmalone
topPRs.body:
As part of superchain-ops, some users require the ability to sign transactions with their Trezor wallet. Right now superchain-ops only supports Foundry walley keystores and Ledgers. This PR changes the interface to superchain-ops signing to allow users to also use Trezor wallets for signing. 

## Testing

### Simulate
- [ ] Ledger
- [ ] Keystore
- [ ] Trezor (Safe 3)
- [ ] Trezor (Safe 5)
- [ ] Trezor (Model One)

### Sign
- [ ] Ledger
- [ ] Keystore
- [ ] Trezor (Safe 3)
- [ ] Trezor (Safe 5)
- [ ] Trezor (Model One)

topPRs.title: ci: shard template regression simulations
topPRs.author: mds1
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- Shards `template_regression_tests` across 4 CircleCI nodes.
- Moves eligible example task selection into `src/script/list-template-example-tasks.sh`.
- Preserves coverage: all 54 eligible example task simulations are still selected exactly once across the 4 shards, and the template coverage check still runs.

## CI history / profile

- Recent `main` CircleCI sample showed `template_regression_tests` consistently at ~8.9-9.9 minutes, while `forge_test` was ~3.8-5.8 minutes and stacked simulations were usually ~2-3 minutes.
- CircleCI build `196531` spent 591s total in `template_regression_tests`, including 561s in `simulate-all-templates`; setup was only about 30s.
- Post-change shard profile with the same `batch_size=7`:
  - before: 54 tasks, 8 simulation batches
  - after: 14 / 14 / 13 / 13 tasks across 4 nodes, 2 batches on the critical path
- PR CI result: `template_regression_tests` passed in 305.8s total on CircleCI build `196763`; the 4 shard simulation actions ran in 206.2s, 220.9s, 220.9s, and 231.9s.

## Test Plan

- [x] `bash test/script/test-template-example-task-sharding.sh`
- [x] `(cd src/script && shellcheck -x *.sh)`
- [x] `shellcheck test/script/test-template-example-task-sharding.sh`
- [x] `forge build --deny-warnings`
- [x] shard union check: all 54 eligible tasks appear exactly once across `CIRCLE_NODE_TOTAL=4`
- [x] `just --justfile src/ci.just --dry-run simulate-all-templates`

Full local `simulate-all-templates` still requires archive RPCs. Running it against public RPC endpoints failed on historical state availability, so the production baseline is taken from CircleCI API timings.

topPRs.title: test: deprecate stale template regression fixtures to improve CI performance
topPRs.author: mds1
topPRs.body:
## Summary

This PR reduces CI runtime by by removing stale, duplicate, or officially deprecation-ready example task fixtures from `template_regression_tests`. For now we also keep the underlying templates in `src/template` to ensure they still compile/work. This is the slowest job and this PR reduces runtime of that job from 8-9 minutes to 5-6 minutes

Most of the tests removed were for contract versions `op-contracts/v5.0.0` or earlier, or duplicates (e.g. regression tests for the same template on mainnet or sepolia). 

## Removed Tests

| Removed Test | Template | Why removal is ok |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `test/tasks/example/eth/005-fp-update-retirement-timestamp` | `UpdateRetirementTimestampV200` | Old fault-proof retirement-timestamp flow for the v2.0 contract era. Template is preserved and allowlisted as deprecated-without-example. |
| `test/tasks/mock/configs/UpdateRetirementTimestampV200.toml` | `UpdateRetirementTimestampV200` | Companion mock config for the same deprecated v2.0 retirement-timestamp regression. |
| `test/tasks/example/eth/007-delayedweth-xfer` | `DelayedWETHOwnershipTemplate` | Historical one-off ownership transfer fixture. Template is preserved and allowlisted; no current recurring workflow depends on this example. |
| `test/tasks/example/eth/009-transfer-owners` | `TransferOwners` | Duplicate template coverage remains in `test/tasks/example/eth/010-transfer-owners-local`, which is README-backed. No allowlist needed. |
| `test/tasks/example/eth/012-gnosis-safe-remove-owner-rehearsal` | `GnosisSafeRemoveOwner` | Duplicate rehearsal fixture. The retained `test/tasks/example/sep/016-gnosis-safe-remove-owner` fixture still covers the template. |
| `test/tasks/example/eth/014-noop-call-optimismportal` | `L1PortalExecuteL2Call` | Historical portal no-op fixture. Template is preserved and allowlisted as deprecated-without-example. |
| `test/tasks/example/eth/015-opcm-upgrade-v500` | `OPCMUpgradeV500` | `op-contracts/v5.0.0` or older upgrade fixture, which is outside current standard-version coverage. Template is preserved and allowlisted. |
| `test/tasks/example/eth/016-revshare-setup` | `RevShareSetup` | Older standalone RevShare setup path superseded by the retained `RevShareUpgradeAndSetup` flow. Template is preserved and allowlisted. |
| `test/tasks/example/sep/001-enable-deputy-pause-module` | `EnableDeputyPauseModuleTemplate` | Old beta DPM example duplicate. The retained `test/tasks/example/sep/010-enable-deputy-pause-module` fixture and mock regression still cover the template. |
| `test/tasks/example/sep/002-opcm-upgrade-v200` | `OPCMUpgradeV200` | Old OPCM v2 fixture. Template is preserved and allowlisted as deprecated-without-example. |
| `test/tasks/example/sep/004-replace-superchain-config` | `UniFix` | Historical Unichain SuperchainConfig fix fixture. Template is preserved and allowlisted as deprecated-without-example. |
| `test/tasks/example/sep/006-opcm-upgrade-v300` | `OPCMUpgradeV300` | Old OPCM v3 fixture. Template is preserved and allowlisted as deprecated-without-example. |
| `test/tasks/example/sep/008-opcm-upgrade-prestate-v300` | `OPCMUpdatePrestateV300` | Old v3 prestate update fixture. Template is preserved and allowlisted as deprecated-without-example. |
| `test/tasks/example/sep/008-opcm-upgrade-v400` | `OPCMUpgradeV400` | Old OPCM v4 fixture. Template is preserved and allowlisted as deprecated-without-example. |
| `test/tasks/example/sep/009-unpause-superchainConfig` | `UnpauseSuperchainConfig` | Pre-v4 unpause path. The template itself points post-v4 users at the newer path; template is preserved and allowlisted. |
| `test/tasks/example/sep/014-set-dispute-game-impl` | `SetDisputeGameImpl` | Duplicate baseline coverage remains in `test/tasks/example/sep/040-set-dispute-game-impl-kona`, which covers the FDG/PDG path plus the newer Kona path. |
| `test/tasks/example/sep/015-welcome-to-superchain-ops` | `WelcomeToSuperchainOps` | Duplicate simple rehearsal fixture. The retained `test/tasks/example/eth/011-welcome-to-superchain-ops` fixture still covers the template. |
| `test/tasks/example/sep/017-gnosis-safe-remove-owner-rehearsal` | `GnosisSafeRemoveOwner` | Duplicate rehearsal fixture. The retained `test/tasks/example/sep/016-gnosis-safe-remove-owner` fixture still covers the template. |
| `test/tasks/example/sep/018-set-eip1967-impl` | `SetEIP1967Implementation` | Duplicate template coverage remains in `test/tasks/example/opsep/001-set-eip1967-impl`, which is README/test-backed. No allowlist needed. |
| `test/tasks/example/sep/019-unpause-superchainConfig` | `UnpauseSuperchainConfigV400` | Old v4 unpause path. Template is preserved and allowlisted as deprecated-without-example. |
| `test/tasks/example/sep/020-blacklist-games-v140` | `BlacklistGamesV140` | Old fault-proof blacklist-games version. Template is preserved and allowlisted as deprecated-without-example. |
| `test/tasks/example/sep/021-blacklist-games-v400` | `BlacklistGamesV400` | Old v4 blacklist-games version. Template is preserved and allowlisted as deprecated-without-example. |
| `test/tasks/example/sep/022-update-retirement-timestamp-v400` | `UpdateRetirementTimestampV400` | Old v4 retirement-timestamp flow. Template is preserved and allowlisted as deprecated-without-example. |
| `test/tasks/example/sep/023-u13-to-u16a` | `OPCMUpgradeV220toV410` | Old U13-to-U16a upgrade path. Template is preserved and allowlisted as deprecated-without-example. |
| `test/tasks/example/sep/024-opcm-upgrade-v410` | `OPCMUpgradeV410` | Old OPCM v4.1 fixture. Template is preserved and allowlisted as deprecated-without-example. |
| `test/tasks/example/sep/025-opcm-upgrade-superchainconfig-v410` | `OPCMUpgradeSuperchainConfigV410` | Old v4.1 SuperchainConfig upgrade fixture. Template is preserved and allowlisted as deprecated-without-example. |
| `test/tasks/example/sep/028-opcm-update-prestate-v410` | `OPCMUpdatePrestateV410` | Old v4.1 prestate update fixture. Template is preserved and allowlisted as deprecated-without-example. |
| `test/tasks/example/sep/029-opcm-upgrade-v500` | `OPCMUpgradeV500` | `op-contracts/v5.0.0` or older upgrade fixture. Template is preserved and allowlisted. |
| `test/tasks/example/sep/030-migrate-to-liveness2` | `MigrateToLiveness2` | Historical one-time Safe migration fixture. Template is preserved and allowlisted; executed task configs still compile under `src/tasks`. |
| `test/tasks/example/sep/031-revshare-setup` | `RevShareSetup` | Older standalone RevShare setup path superseded by the retained `RevShareUpgradeAndSetup` flow. Template is preserved and allowlisted. |
| `test/tasks/example/sep/032-revshare-upgrade-and-setup-sony-ink` | `RevShareUpgradeAndSetup` | Duplicate Sepolia coverage. The retained mainnet fixture and `RevShareContractsUpgraderIntegrationTest` still cover this template path. |
